title: Emissions by demand sector
sub: Direct CO2 from industry, including industrial processes, and from buildings, with agricultural methane and nitrous oxide in CO2-equivalent. Direct means the emissions released in the sector, not those of the electricity and heat it buys.

panels.title: Industry
panels.formed: Industrial energy demand plus industrial process CO2, excluding the emissions of the electricity and heat industry buys

panels.title: Buildings
panels.formed: Residential and commercial energy demand CO2, excluding the emissions of the electricity and heat buildings buy

panels.title: Agriculture, non-CO2
panels.formed: Agricultural CH4 x 27.9 plus N2O x 273 (AR6 GWP100)
